README.md.rationale: Bounded Order106 source-backed movement obligation repair and required runtime identity publication. The owner-approved sequential policy selects serial smoke for this repair; no deliberate performance change or demonstrated serious regression.
README.md.source_obligation: Order106/P12C/C12-05 implements rule12.03 block12: moved models approach the initially closest selected Pile In target and engage it if legally attainable; preserve source-backed budgets, coherent witnessed paths, continuing engagements and unresolved-proof failure.
README.md.unchanged_work: Pile In now invokes the existing shared per-model closest-target and authenticated movement-reachability authority already used by Consolidation. The existing solver, path validation, cache and search algorithms are unchanged; Pile In supplies its own existing movement permissions, budget and continuing-engagement constraints. A moved model already engaging its initially closest target needs no reachability query. The added source-required query for a moved nonengaging model is assessed as a bounded semantic repair under the owner's explicit smoke-default policy, not a deliberate performance change. Full current semantic/work/cache checks remain mandatory. Historical performance identities and measurements are unchanged; no full-game certification is claimed.
